headlines.summary_en: The 24th session of the Standing Committee of the 14th National People's Congress was held in Beijing from August 25 to 28. The State Council's report on the implementation of the national economic and social development plan for this year was submitted for review at this session. The report shows that since the beginning of this year, the national economy has generally operated steadily with progress, and social stability has been maintained. In the first half of the year, GDP grew 4.7% year-on-year, with an incremental increase of 3.6 trillion yuan, the highest for the same period in five years. Wang Changlin, Deputy Director of the National Development and Reform Commission, stated that based on current economic and social development data and information from various sources, the plan's implementation is generally sound. Indicators such as economic growth, employment, prices, and foreign trade imports and exports met expectations, while market consumption and resident income indicators grew steadily. headlines.title: 超500款理财产品调整业绩比较基准
headlines.summary: 近期，工银理财、农银理财、中邮理财、兴银理财等多家理财公司发布公告，将旗下部分理财产品的业绩比较基准从数值区间型切换为挂钩债券指数、存款利率、股市指数等各种市场指数的公式型基准。以某款“固收+”理财产品为例，新的业绩比较基准调整为：中债-新综合全价指数收益率*92.00%+沪深300指数收益率*3.00%+人民银行公布的个人活期存款利率*5.00%。据不完全统计，8月以来，业绩比较基准“换锚”的相关公告合计超500条。这次调整的核心，就是把过去的数值区间，变成一套“看市场”的动态公式。理财产品每一分收益都能在新的业绩比较基准中找到对应的市场来源。

headlines.summary_en: Recently, multiple wealth management companies including ICBC Wealth Management, ABC Wealth Management, China Post Wealth Management, and Xingye Wealth Management issued announcements switching the performance comparison benchmarks for certain wealth management products from numerical ranges to formula-based benchmarks linked to bond indices, deposit rates, stock market indices, and other market indices. Taking a 'fixed income plus' product as an example, the new benchmark is: ChinaBond New Comprehensive All-Price Index return * 92.00% + CSI 300 Index return * 3.00% + PBOC personal demand deposit rate * 5.00%. According to incomplete statistics, since August, over 500 related announcements on benchmark 're-anchoring' have been issued. The core of this adjustment is transforming past numerical ranges into dynamic 'market-based' formulas, where every bit of product return can be traced to a corresponding market source in the new benchmark.

headlines.title: 富达国际：通胀逐渐演变成长期结构性趋势，看好黄金、金属与矿业类股
headlines.summary: 富达国际基金经理人Ian Samson指出，发达国家通胀率已连续6年高于央行目标水准，显示通胀不再只是景气循环现象，而是逐渐演变成长期结构性趋势。投资人应重新调整投资布局，大宗商品建议黄金，以及受惠全球电气化与能源转型趋势的金属与矿业类股，以因应高通胀新常态。

headlines.summary_en: Ian Samson, portfolio manager at Fidelity International, noted that inflation in developed economies has exceeded central bank targets for six consecutive years, indicating inflation is no longer merely a cyclical phenomenon but gradually evolving into a long-term structural trend. Investors should reposition their portfolios, with commodities advice favoring gold and metals and mining stocks benefiting from global electrification and energy transition trends, to cope with the new normal of high inflation.

headlines.title: 阿根廷众议院通过总统的央行改革方案
headlines.summary: 阿根廷众议院通过了总统哈维尔·米莱提出的央行改革法案，禁止央行在未来为政府支出提供融资。 该法案总体表决以144票赞成、102票反对、9票弃权获得通过。 将投票拆分为逐条逐款表决的动议被否决。 第一章共包含18项条款，以138票赞成、110票反对、7票弃权获得通过。 第二章以142票赞成、107票反对、6票弃权获得通过。 该法案将提交参议院进行辩论和投票。

headlines.summary_en: Argentina's Chamber of Deputies approved President Javier Milei's central bank reform bill, prohibiting the central bank from financing government spending in the future. The bill passed with 144 votes in favor, 102 against, and 9 abstentions in the overall vote. A motion to split the vote into article-by-article votes was rejected. Chapter One, containing 18 articles, passed with 138 in favor, 110 against, and 7 abstentions. Chapter Two passed with 142 in favor, 107 against, and 6 abstentions. The bill now goes to the Senate for debate and voting.

headlines.summary_en: Yu Weining, chief statistician at the NBS Industry Department, interpreted January-July 2026 industrial enterprise profit data. During this period, the manufacturing sector's transformation toward mid-to-high ends of the industrial and value chains continued. Profits of high-tech manufacturing above designated size rose 50.1% year-on-year, contributing 9.6 percentage points to profit growth of all industrial enterprises above designated size. By industry, within electronic and communication equipment manufacturing, optical fiber manufacturing, optical cable manufacturing, and communication system equipment manufacturing profits grew 468.4%, 62.6%, and 55.0% respectively; within medical instrument and equipment and instrumentation manufacturing, navigation, surveying, meteorology, and ocean special instrument manufacturing profits rose 157.8%, and dental equipment and appliance manufacturing profits rose 74.5%.

headlines.title: 投资“放大器”效应显现，多家上市险企上半年利润高增长
headlines.summary: 截至8月26日，A股和港股已有5家上市险企披露2026年上半年“成绩单”。报告期内，受益于权益市场上行，这些上市险企归母净利润普遍高增长。在市场人士看来，上半年相关上市险企业绩高增长背后，投资收益大幅增长是主要贡献因素。自新会计准则实行以来，保险公司投资资产更多被分类为FVTPL（以公允价值计量且其变动计入当期损益）资产，尤其是大部分科技股被纳入FVTPL，其股价波动显著影响了险企利润。不过，也有业内人士认为，FVTPL分类其实是一把“双刃剑”，当权益市场大幅上涨时会增厚险企业绩，资本市场调整时则会对险企业绩形成拖累。（上证报）

headlines.summary_en: As of August 26, five listed insurers on A-shares and Hong Kong stocks have disclosed their first-half 2026 results. During the reporting period, benefiting from rising equity markets, net profits attributable to parent companies generally grew rapidly. Market participants believe that strong investment income growth was the main contributor behind the high performance growth of these listed insurers in the first half. Since the adoption of new accounting standards, insurers' investment assets are increasingly classified as FVTPL (fair value through profit or loss), especially most tech stocks being included in FVTPL, whose price fluctuations significantly impact insurer profits. However, some industry insiders argue that FVTPL classification is a 'double-edged sword': it boosts insurer performance when equity markets surge, but weighs on performance during market corrections. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计通胀率将在相当长一段时间内持续高于目标水平。 未来通胀走向面临较高不确定性，主要与油价、汇率、内需复苏节奏以及工资上涨扩散程度相关。 将继续实施能将CPI通胀率稳定在目标水平的货币政策。 在出口和投资保持高增长的推动下，预计国内经济将继续维持强劲增长。 消费复苏步伐将逐渐加快。 将评估通胀、国内经济以及金融稳定状况。 需要密切关注居民债务增长情况。 芯片领域的扩张程度、中东局势发展以及贸易环境的变化仍存在不确定性。

headlines.summary_en: Bank of Korea: Inflation is expected to remain above target for a considerable period. Future inflation trajectory faces significant uncertainty, mainly related to oil prices, exchange rates, the pace of domestic demand recovery, and the diffusion of wage increases. Will continue to implement monetary policy that stabilizes CPI inflation at the target level. Supported by sustained high growth in exports and investment, the domestic economy is expected to continue posting strong growth. The pace of consumption recovery will gradually pick up. Will assess inflation, domestic economy, and financial stability conditions. Need to closely monitor household debt growth. Uncertainties remain regarding the scale of chip sector expansion, developments in the Middle East, and changes in the trade environment.

headlines.title: 外资不断对开放中国市场投下信任票
headlines.summary: 随着中国持续推进高水平对外开放，外资企业在华发展驱动力不断增强。近日，日立能源（中国）有限公司在合肥全球变压器组件运营中心举行分接开关数字化新产线落成暨特高压套管项目奠基仪式上，正式对外公布在中国启动总额约3亿美元的战略投资。据悉，这是该外企近年来在华最具规模的投资项目之一。如今外资在华布局正逐步从“在中国生产”转向“在中国研发、服务全球”。“外资持续加码中国市场，核心是看中了中国市场‘量’与‘质’的双重优势，超大规模市场与消费升级机遇以及强劲的科技创新与产业升级机遇。”安徽大学经济学院金融学系主任邓道才副教授说。（新华社）

headlines.title_en: Foreign investors continue to cast votes of confidence in China's opening market
headlines.summary_en: As China continues to advance high-level opening-up, the driving force for foreign enterprises' development in China keeps strengthening. Recently, Hitachi Energy (China) Co., Ltd. officially announced the launch of a strategic investment totaling approximately $300 million in China at the groundbreaking ceremony for its tap-changer digital production line and UHV bushing project at the Hefei Global Transformer Components Operation Center. It is reported that this is one of the largest investment projects by the foreign company in China in recent years. Foreign investment in China is now gradually shifting from 'producing in China' to 'R&D in China, serving the world.' 'Foreign capital's continued increased investment in the Chinese market is fundamentally driven by the dual advantages of market 'quantity' and 'quality,' including the opportunities from the super-large market and consumption upgrading, as well as strong technological innovation and industrial upgrading opportunities,' said Deng Daocai, associate professor and head of the Finance Department at Anhui University's School of Economics. (Xinhua News Agency)

headlines.title: 781份创业板半年报扫描，超七成公司盈利，AI产业链高景气度持续验证
headlines.summary: 创业板公司2026年半年报已披露过半。总体来看，创业板公司交出了一份营收快速增长、盈利能力增强、龙头继续领跑、行业亮点突出的答卷。据统计，截至2026年8月26日早间，创业板1403家公司中有781家披露了2026年半年度报告，合计实现营业收入1.61万亿元，同比增长24.04%；合计实现归属于上市公司股东的净利润1485.35亿元，同比增长43.27%，合计实现扣除非经常性损益后的净利润1301.77亿元，同比增长43.90%。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Scan of 781 ChiNext half-year reports: over 70% of companies profitable, AI industry chain's high prosperity continues to be validated
headlines.summary_en: Over half of ChiNext companies' 2026 semi-annual reports have been disclosed. Overall, ChiNext companies delivered results featuring rapid revenue growth, improved profitability, continued leadership by bellwethers, and standout industry highlights. According to statistics, as of the morning of August 26, 2026, 781 of the 1,403 ChiNext companies had disclosed their 2026 semi-annual reports, with combined operating revenue reaching 1.61 trillion yuan, up 24.04% year-on-year; combined net profit attributable to listed companies' shareholders reaching 148.535 billion yuan, up 43.27% year-on-year; and combined net profit excluding non-recurring gains and losses reaching 130.177 billion yuan, up 43.90% year-on-year. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 韩国央行：预计2026年GDP增长率为3.3%，此前预测为2.6%
headlines.summary: 韩国央行：预计2026年GDP增长率为3.3%，此前预测为2.6%。 预计2027年GDP增长率为2.9%，此前预测为2.1%。 预计2026年CPI上涨2.7%，与5月份的预测一致。 预计2027年CPI上涨2.3%，与5月份的预测一致。

headlines.title_en: Bank of Korea: 2026 GDP growth forecast raised to 3.3% from 2.6%
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Korea: 2026 GDP growth forecast raised to 3.3%, from a previous 2.6%. 2027 GDP growth forecast raised to 2.9%, from a previous 2.1%. 2026 CPI inflation forecast at 2.7%, unchanged from the May projection. 2027 CPI inflation forecast at 2.3%, unchanged from the May projection.

headlines.title_en: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino: Inflation expected to exceed 2% in the second half of the current fiscal year
headlines.summary_en: Bank of Japan Deputy Governor Ryozo Himino: Inflation is expected to exceed 2% in the second half of the current fiscal year. A weak yen may boost global companies' earnings and stimulate tourism spending, but could impact small and medium-sized enterprises' profits by raising import costs.
